name: Shared Fury
summary: Maseara Autumnmoon asks you to answer a growing demon threat in the forest. She believes quelling it may help an anguished soul.

sections.title: A Written Plea
sections.body: Kurothel's words reach Maseara Autumnmoon in Forest Song, where sightings of wolf-men have grown more common. Druids had been trying to speak with those who showed control over their animal instincts. Yet Kurothel's writing points to a struggle tied to demons and a burning transformation. Maseara asks you to confront the Xavian and its demonic forces, hoping that may help him.

faq.answer: Maseara Autumnmoon in Forest Song asks you to confront the Xavian and its demonic forces.
They are described as members of a pack now seen in greater numbers in the forest.

faq.q: What were the druids trying to do?
faq.answer: The druids were pursuing communication with those of the beast heart who showed measured control of their animal instincts.

faq.q: Why does Maseara want the demons confronted?
faq.answer: Maseara believes quelling the demon threat driving a burning transformation may help an anguished soul.
Maseara Autumnmoon is in Forest Song.
